title: About Teigh Wade, REALTOR®
seoTitle: About Teigh Wade, Arizona Native in Surprise | Teigh Wade REALTOR®
description: Meet Teigh Wade, REALTOR® with HomeSmart Elite Group: an Arizona native in Surprise, a notary since 2010 and a home stager for West Valley sellers.
summary: I'm Teigh Wade, REALTOR® with HomeSmart Elite Group, HomeSmart. I'm an Arizona native, born in Phoenix, I've lived mostly in the West Valley, and I live in Surprise. I help buyers and sellers across the Valley, I've been a notary public since 2010, and I offer home staging for my listing clients.

sections.html:
I'm Teigh Wade, a REALTOR® with HomeSmart Elite Group, HomeSmart. You might also know me as Tyra Wade or Tyra Woods-Wade, or simply as “T.” A lot of people call me “The Real T,” and I take that seriously. With me, you get THE Real T!

I'm an Arizona native. I was born in Phoenix and have lived mostly in the West Valley, and today I live in Surprise. I work all over the Valley, including Surprise, Waddell, Wickenburg, Phoenix, Glendale, Peoria, Sun City, Sun City West, El Mirage, Goodyear, Buckeye and Litchfield Park, and I represent buyers and sellers throughout Arizona.

I'm licensed with the Arizona Department of Real Estate as a salesperson under the name Teigh Wade, license number SA709148000.

I've wanted to work in real estate since the early 2000s. Over the years, one belief has stayed at the center of how I work, and I'll say it in my own words:

“Getting The Sale” is NOT my mission. Helping people navigate through every process of Real Estate is.

Buying or selling a home is a big decision, and it comes with contracts, deadlines, inspections, appraisals and a lot of new terms. I want you to understand every step, ask every question and feel confident in each choice you make. If that means taking extra time to explain the BINSR or walking through a CMA line by line, that's what I'll do.

sections.h2: How I work with buyers and sellers
sections.html:
I come to you. My buyer and listing consultations are mobile, so we can meet at your home or somewhere convenient for you.

For sellers, I handle pricing strategy with a comparative market analysis, listing preparation, staging, photos and marketing, showings and negotiation all the way through closing. Learn more on my sell your home page or find out what your home is worth.

For buyers, I provide pre-approval referrals, home tours, offers, negotiation, help through inspections and support all the way to closing. Start on my buy a home page, or if this is your first purchase, my first-time home buyers page.

I also have a strong referral network of lenders, title companies, inspectors and other professionals. I don't set or promise interest rates, but I can connect you with people who can answer those questions.

I love helping a home show at its best. I offer staging consultations with a room-by-room plan, hands-on staging using your own furniture and decor, and full staging with my own furniture and decor, including for vacant homes. Staging help is included for my listing clients. If you only want staging, call me to talk about rates. You can read more on my home staging page.

I've been a notary public serving the Surprise area since 2010, and I offer mobile notary service statewide. I've completed the National Notary Association certified signing agent program and have experience with mortgage and loan documents. That background helps me in real estate too, because I've seen a lot of closing paperwork up close.

I offer short-notice and emergency appointments and travel to homes, offices, hospitals, care facilities and public places. Learn more on my mobile notary and loan signing agent pages. I'm also a certified wedding officiant.

“More Than Just a REALTOR®” isn't just a tagline for me. I'm also a Licensed Massage Therapist, a licensed insurance producer in Arizona, a Reiki Master/Teacher and a hypnotherapist, and I work in web design. Real estate comes first, but these other parts of my life shape how I listen and how I care for the people I work with. You can read about them on my more than a REALTOR® page.

At home, I share my space with three dogs, Monsieur Olie', Paris and ChiChi, plus a rat named Templeton. They keep life interesting.

What I love most about this work is meeting people and watching them succeed, whether that's handing over keys to a new home, helping a seller move on to the next chapter or getting an important document signed on time. If you'd like to talk, call or text me at 480-550-2871 or email tyrawadehomes@gmail.com. I'd love to meet you.

faqs.a: I'm Teigh Wade, a REALTOR® with HomeSmart Elite Group, HomeSmart, based in Surprise, Arizona. I'm an Arizona native, born in Phoenix, and I've lived mostly in the West Valley. faqs.q: What brokerage is Teigh Wade with?
faqs.a: I'm with HomeSmart Elite Group, HomeSmart. HomeSmart is my employing broker with the Arizona Department of Real Estate, and HomeSmart Elite Group is the team I work with. My Arizona salesperson license is under the name Teigh Wade, license number SA709148000.

faqs.q: What areas does Teigh Wade serve?
faqs.a: I'm based in Surprise and work in Surprise, Waddell, Wickenburg, Phoenix and the greater West Valley, including Glendale, Peoria, Sun City, Sun City West, El Mirage, Goodyear, Buckeye and Litchfield Park. I also represent buyers and sellers throughout Arizona. My consultations are mobile, so I come to you wherever you are.

It's my nickname and my promise. People call me “T” and “The Real T,” and “With me, you get THE Real T!” means you get me, honestly and directly, through every step. I'll tell you what I really think about pricing, repairs and offers, and I'll explain everything so you can make your own informed decisions.

faqs.q: Does Teigh Wade offer services besides real estate?
faqs.a: Yes. Besides real estate and home staging, I'm a mobile notary and loan signing agent, a certified wedding officiant, a Licensed Massage Therapist, a licensed insurance producer in Arizona, a Reiki Master/Teacher and a hypnotherapist, and I do web design. Real estate is my main focus. The more than a REALTOR® page covers the rest.

faqs.q: How do I contact Teigh Wade?
faqs.a: For real estate, call or text 480-550-2871 or email tyrawadehomes@gmail.com. For notary appointments, call 833-363-7244. I'm based in Surprise and don't publish an office address because I come to you for consultations and appointments. Tell me a little about what you need, and I'll get back to you.
